newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Baltimore, Md..

text.p: Mayor and City Council of Baltimore

Sealed bids will be received by the Bureau of Treasury Management Department of Finance of the City of Baltimore, Maryland on behalf of the Mayor and City Council of Baltimore (the City'' nd at the time and place shown below:
(unless another date for opening bids is established

pursuant to the procedure set forth in the Notice of Sale for each series described below) for each of the above series of bonds to be dated June 1, 1997 and mature serially on October 15, 1998 through October 15, 2017.

Each series of Bonds is to be issued for the purposes and pursuant to the authorities set forth in the Preliminary Official Statement. Each series of Bonds will be valid and legally binding general obligations of the City for which its faith and credit are pledged. Each series of Bonds is payable as to principal and interest from ad valorem taxes which the City is empowered, obligated and directed by law to levy, without limitation, upon all assessable property within the corporate boundaries of the City, in each year in rate and amount sufficient for such purposes until all of the Bonds and the interest thereon shall have been paid or provision shall have been made for such payment. Neither series of Bonds is guaranteed by the State of Maryland nor any other entity, except the City.

All bids must be accompanied with a good faith deposit and submitted in accordance with the terms and conditions of the Notice of Sale for each series. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, Notice of Sale and bid proposal form for each series will be furnished to any prospective bidder upon request to G. Louise Green, Chief, Bureau of Treasury Management, Department of Finance, and Clerk of the Board of Finance, 100 Guilford Avenue, Baltimore, Maryland 21202 (Telephone: 410-396-4752; Telecopier: 410-396-7381 or 410- 396-5876).
The City reserves the right to reject any and all bids and to waive irregularities.
